description: Gather facts from ZFS dataset properties.

parameters.name: parsable
parameters.description: Specifies if property values should be displayed in machine friendly format. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Specifies which dataset properties should be queried in comma-separated format. For more information about dataset properties, check zfs(1M) man page. Default: "all"

parameters.name: recurse
parameters.description: Specifies if properties for any children should be recursively displayed. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Specifies which datasets types to display. Multiple values have to be provided as a list or in comma-separated form. Value all cannot be used together with other values. Choices: "all" ← (default) "filesystem" "volume" "snapshot" "bookmark" Default: ["all"]

examples:
- name: Gather facts about ZFS dataset rpool/export/home
  community.general.zfs_facts:
    dataset: rpool/export/home

- name: Report space usage on ZFS filesystems under data/home
  community.general.zfs_facts:
    name: data/home
    recurse: true
    type: filesystem

- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: 'ZFS dataset {{ item.name }} consumes {{ item.used }} of disk space.'
  with_items: '{{ ansible_zfs_datasets }}'

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: ZFS dataset name. Returned: always Sample: "rpool/var/spool"

return_values.name: parsable
return_values.description: If parsable output should be provided in machine friendly format. Returned: if parsable=True Sample: true

return_values.name: recurse
return_values.description: If we should recurse over ZFS dataset. Returned: if recurse=True Sample: true

return_values.name: zfs_datasets
return_values.description: ZFS dataset facts.
